# Numerical regression fixtures

These saved amplitudes, waveform summaries and cluster maps are inputs to the
library's regression tests. Participant identifiers, units, configurations and
numerical values are retained from the
[recorded comparison](https://github.com/dengzhe-hou/auto-eeg-analysis/tree/995f53d42cc74205b164e8711d4b289b8c2ad3a1/tools/benchmark).

The tests check the measured ERP agreement, backend metadata, observed t-maps,
cluster partitions and both threshold modes. Certification coverage is described
in [the coverage record](../../../../docs/CERTIFICATION_LEVELS.md).
